source_citation: Diggs, Lipscomb & O'Kennon (1999), Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas

morphology_source_reported.stems: Trailing, not twining; appressed-pubescent, to 2 m long
morphology_source_reported.leaves: Elliptic to orbicular-ovate leaflets; lower surface prominently reticulate-veined (key)
morphology_source_reported.fruits: Small, peanut-like single-seeded underground fruits from cleistogamous flowers, in addition to aboveground fruits
morphology_source_reported.diagnostic_characters: Underground cleistogamous flowers and fruits; conspicuous underside venation; non-twining stems
